title: One long video into a useful short-form campaign
topic: How to turn one long video into a useful short-form campaign
notes: Show a beginner-friendly workflow: one practical long-form lesson, two curiosity-building teasers before publication, and five simple follow-up shorts after publication.
expectedWorkflow: Review and edit the topic and foundation notes.
Generate or write the long-form brief first.
Use pre-launch shorts to create curiosity and communicate the promise.
Use post-launch shorts to extend the lesson with practical follow-ups.
Review evidence warnings before recording or publishing.
Use simple CapCut montage and DaVinci Resolve correction guidance.
